description: Trigger: peering/auth.rs in_frame[..32].try_into().unwrap() and in_frame[32..].try_into().unwrap() convert fixed-length slices to [u8; 32] arrays. The unwrap() calls are safe because the slices are exactly 32 bytes by construction, but there is no comment explaining why. Bad behavior: future maintainers who refactor the frame length may not notice the hidden invariant and introduce a panic. The idiomatic fix is either a comment or splitting off named arrays to make the invariant explicit.
title: peering/auth.rs uses unwrap() on guaranteed-success slice try_into() without comment
